449190.overview: Phrase Craze is a 1988 game for up to three players by Reedy Software for the Adam computer that is very reminiscent of the Wheel of Fortune game on Television and was slated to includ several other phrase packs to keep the game fresh and exciting.

451013.overview: Pity plays much like the board game Sorry, where you must slide your pieces into your home space while knocking out your opponents.
